THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: The source of distortion, I'm here to correct you
I am right, I am just, you unreasonable people
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Is this going back? I feel the distortion at the top of the tower again...
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Take your pick! As long as you understand their value!
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Take your pick! As long as you understand their value!
Is it right to pursue it wholeheartedly? Then go find an architect. My collection will always be here waiting for you——!
you! you! Climb so high! ! Shining justice! ! for you! Become stronger!
you! you! Climb so high! ! Shining justice! ! for you! Become stronger!
Power should not be given so easily... What are your intentions?
Lonely...Want to see the light! Want to see win! Thinking of the bad guys is broken! ! Take it! Go fight! I'm here to watch!
...I understand, I will use it to protect justice, not for you
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Take it...a part of me...to give you peace...
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Take it...a part of me...to give you peace...
The tower... is too noisy... you go fight... to quell the architect's twisted correctness.
I accept this power, I will correct the architect, just like I corrected my past self
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HI: Righteous traveler...power comes at a price
Righteous traveler...power comes at a price
I am willing to bear the price for my sinless ideal
Well, the fire is with you... don't let it... consume you...
I will control it and illuminate the top of the tower with this burning justice
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HI: Traveler, do you long for beauty and luck? Take my gift and let the tower shine for you
Traveler, do you long for beauty and luck? Take my gift and let the tower shine for you
I am willing to exchange strength for peace and end the chaos here
Very good. May your journey be filled with flowers and all your cards become treasures. Go for the beauty in your soul.
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0-: Weak! Come and fight me! If you win, I will give you strength!
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1-: Weak! Come and fight me! If you win, I will give you strength!
That's not true, my enemy is the distortion at the top of the tower
Ha ha! interesting! The strong weak, use my power to correct everything!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.0: Have strong faith and kill that abominable architect! !
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.1: Have strong faith and kill that abominable architect! !
Not correct! evil! When I correct the inaccuracies on the top of the tower, I will burn you devil!
OK OK! What a delusion, let’s see how far your ridiculous justice can go!
[i] (Hiro frowned and tightened his grip on the sword) Disgusting [/i]
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_WITCHOFTHE_ISLAND.pag: During your exploration, you encounter an ancient being called the Island Witch.
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_WITCHOFTHE_ISLAND.tal: [i] (Although it is very weak, there is indeed sound) [/i]
I only hope that [color=#cccccc] she [/color]... can find her own  happiness  while coexisting with humans.
I want you to convey to [color=#cccccc] her [/color]...[color=#cccccc] her [/color] no longer has to bear the so-called [jitter] fate of being born a witch [/jitter]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Are you here, lock yourself up?
Ah...you have a very special aura about you. Not a creature of the Spire, nor an ordinary mortal. That...cursed power
Once you step into this place, you can never look back
Once you step into this place, you can never look back
Even if the road ahead is difficult, I will not back down
New little guy! Come and see my collection?!
New little guy! Come and see my collection?!
I'm just passing by, I don't have anything to exchange for.
It’s okay, take your pick! Come here often!
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EMALI: Found it! Found it! ! This one doesn’t look good…this one is shiny! ! But that's not right! ! What Eurobas is looking for is——
Found it! Found it! ! This one doesn’t look good…this one is shiny! ! But that's not right! ! What Eurobas is looking for is——
That, hello. I was passing by. Is this... your home?
Here you go - get these! ! Bring some sparkle! ! My heart will feel warmer! !
There are many people who are better than me. Someone who really helps...thank you
...There are new guests coming. Don’t worry, these molten bits won’t burn you. Take a seat
...There are new guests coming. Don’t worry, these molten bits won’t burn you. Take a seat
...Don't you think I'm weird? A person runs into a tower, knows nothing, and always causes trouble for others.
I was melting all the time. every day. all the time. Others think I am disappearing - but in fact I am reborn. The old flows away and the new will grow. There is pain, but it's not a bad thing
...I will come again. not for your part
Learn from me and find some peace
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EM: You humans are all the same. Come in with flaws, leave with determination - and come back with new flaws, welcome back
You humans are all the same. Come in with flaws, leave with determination - and come back with new flaws, welcome back
Forgive yourself first. Those who burn off their shortcomings are qualified to start from scratch
Thank you, I'm a little lighter, but I'm walking more steadily than before.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EM: Oops, your outfit looks a bit boring. Come on, let me pick something beautiful to wear for you.
Oops, your outfit looks a bit boring. Come on, let me pick something beautiful to wear for you.
...boring? This is already my most formal outfit

A noble visitor deserves noble blessings. Little girl, power lies not in what you have done in the past, but in what you want to do now. Put on my power and go destroy the madness at the top of the tower
Too weak! Don’t you even have the strength to hold onto your weapon? !
Too weak! Don’t you even have the strength to hold onto your weapon? !
...Um, hello. My name is Sakuraba Emma. I'm really... not very good at using weapons.
You don't wield the sword, but you are already judging others! The mouth is also a powerful weapon! ! The dark red one doesn't want to fight me, and neither do you! But you are all so funny!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_EMALIN: Ah—Emma Sakuraba. It's finally here. I've been waiting for you for a long, long time. Give yourself to me and you will become as feared as I am!
Ah—Emma Sakuraba. It's finally here. I've been waiting for you for a long, long time. Give yourself to me and you will become as feared as I am!
I won't sign it. Being forgiven is not a transaction. People like you will never understand - because you don't feel anything needs to be forgiven
Too weak. A little girl who doesn't even have the strength to hold a weapon wants to threaten the devil? !
You're not helping them. You are turning them into puppets. Become more like you. I don't need this help
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Wow, we are at the top of the tower. Is this the truth of everything!?
Pure power, pure emotion, useless puppet
Go back and find the filling and come again
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Another awakening soul... I feel an unusual aura in you. You seem... not afraid at all?
Another awakening soul... I feel an unusual aura in you. You seem... not afraid at all?
My name is Shirley Tachibana, and I am a detective!
Detective...are you here to find the truth? The secrets hidden in this tower are enough to drive most people crazy
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Dafo is groping in a pile of metal fragments, mumbling to himself
Dafo is groping in a pile of metal fragments, mumbling to himself

Wow, so many collections of unknown origins are really interesting~
With so many collections in your possession, would you deliberately hide a key piece of evidence? For example, props that can reveal the truth about the spire and the mystery of the secret room?

[jitter]【Daf laughed loudly】[/jitter]
I just like to share my favorites! If you break into the tower and pick up something rare later, remember to come back and exchange new items with me.
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERR: Visitors!! Stories and puzzles! Detective story!
Visitors!! Stories and puzzles! Detective story!
My story? My story is not very interesting, but I know many other people’s stories, whether they are detective novels or happenings~

Tachibana Shirley has been sharing the stories she knows
Interesting! interesting!

The story as I know it is over.
Eh~ Your own existence is the biggest unsolved mystery of the Spire? You are also looking for your own truth, right?
Then go for it! Deconstruct all the mysteries of this spire!
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: If you're tired... just stop and take a rest. The road to the minaret is too hard, the wind and snow are too cold
If you're tired... just stop and take a rest. The road to the minaret is too hard, the wind and snow are too cold
I'm Detective Tangerine Shirley, and I'm taking the liberty of disturbing your rest. Is it painful or tiring for you to keep sharing your flesh and blood with strangers?
Your eyes are very clean and pure. My body can grow indefinitely, and there is no need to regret or feel bad about it.
The duty of a detective is to see all the ignored truths~
Thank you... I hope you don't have to be tough and will always be treated with gentleness...
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SH: Come close to the light and let my flames warm you and heal you.
Come close to the light and let my flames warm you and heal you.
My name is Detective Tachibana Shirley. Thank you for your willingness to share your warmth with stranger climbers.
The long road to the steeple is bitterly cold, and the fighting and darkness never stop. I was born of fire and was born to spread light.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SH: Little one who has come from afar, welcome to my gorgeous territory.
Little one who has come from afar, welcome to my gorgeous territory.
Hello! Your palace is so beautiful, and you are even more elegant and luxurious. You are the most delicate and gentle person I have ever seen in the minaret.
Haha, very discerning. You look very well-behaved, but your clothes are too simple and monotonous. No problem, since you are here, I will give you opportunities and gorgeous blessings.
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Another climber who sets foot in the arena! The fighting in the steeple never stops, so come and join me in a fierce battle to stretch your muscles!
Another climber who sets foot in the arena! The fighting in the steeple never stops, so come and join me in a fierce battle to stretch your muscles!
Hey~ I’m a bit strong~ Let’s try it without weapons!

【Being beaten away by Tachibana Shirley】
[jitter] Uh-huh, little detective, big strength! interesting! It’s rare to find a little guy who understands me! [/jitter]
These relics do not need to be exchanged, they are purely given to you. Even if you don't like fighting, I hope you have the confidence to face all dangers!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRY: oh? Another little guy stepping into the contract palace. It seems that you also long for the power to reach the sky in one step. Are you willing to pay any price to make a good deal with me?
oh? Another little guy stepping into the contract palace. It seems that you also long for the power to reach the sky in one step. Are you willing to pay any price to make a good deal with me?
It sounds like a very tempting deal, but I also know that you enjoy watching mortals trapped in desires and in dilemmas.

The little guy has a sharp eye! All living beings have obsessions. Greed, revenge, and ambition to reach the top are all my best bargaining chips. As long as I offer a little sweetness, they will take the initiative to offer their bottom line. This game will never get tired of playing.

Pure evil, you have only one emotion and you are not worth learning from me
Tachibana Shirley ignored Waku who was still talking and left directly
NONUPEIPE.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_AN: Ah, a little writer from far away. You hide yourself in such dark colors, and you clutch that notebook hard enough to crease it.
Ah, a little writer from far away. You hide yourself in such dark colors, and you clutch that notebook hard enough to crease it.
[Natsume Anan steps half a pace back and hugs her sketchbook tighter.] I did not come here to be looked at.
Hehe, don't tense up. Beauty is not only for clothing; it can hide in wishes written on paper. Take my blessing, and let your words catch a little fortune and shine.
TANX.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Another challenger! Do not hide your face in that notebook! Come, take up a weapon and show me your courage!
Another challenger! Do not hide your face in that notebook! Come, take up a weapon and show me your courage!
I am ill suited to combat. If proof is required, words and schemes can also make someone fall into defeat.
Ha! What a gloomy fighting spirit! You speak of victory without raising a fist? Interesting! Take my strength and write your script to the end!
VAKUU.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLI: Oh? A little one hiding behind pages. How many endings have you written where you wished to start over? I can offer a contract to rewrite every nuisance in your way.
Oh? A little one hiding behind pages. How many endings have you written where you wished to start over? I can offer a contract to rewrite every nuisance in your way.
I already know what hollowness remains when one borrows another's hand to rewrite an ending. A contract is only another kind of brainwashing.
You speak as if you have tasted the fall already. Good. I like those who understand the price.
That is why I will not sign it. If the story is to continue, it cannot rely on stealing another person's will.
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN:
I only wish to find a quiet corner where no one will disturb me for a short rest.
[Anan presses the tip of her pen hard into the paper.]
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANL: Doll, doll! You made it all the way up here!
If someday you want to, I can sit quietly here and listen while your pen tells the whole story!! I will never hurry you to speak!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Tiny weaver of lies, you have climbed to the root of the world.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_AN: A rare quiet traveler! Are you afraid of burning power?
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: It is the peaceful daily life I long for in writing, only an empty dream entrusted to words......
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Using another person's life to settle a private grudge is nothing more than your script of revenge.
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Come rest here. Climbing the tower is so tiring......
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Very well. Choose one blessing to take with you; the climb is dangerous.
Well now, a rare guest! Few people come to my collection room alone. Look around and choose whatever you like.
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANL: They are only poor works I idly invented, with shallow plots unfit for anyone's eyes.
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Your mental arts are rather interesting. Very well, choose a blessing as you wish, but do not fall too early on the road.
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANL: Doll, doll! You made it all the way up here!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: Foolish beyond measure. The empty obsession of a mere mortal cannot shake the will that built the entire world.
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANL: [Natsume Anan stops at a distance, arms locked around her sketchbook, deliberately keeping away from close contact.]
DARV.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Well now, a rare guest! Few people come to my collection room alone. Look around and choose whatever you like.
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Offer me your prayer, and I shall grant you the power to climb.
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Anan instinctively hugs her sketchbook tighter and takes a small step back. After hesitating for a long while, she lowers her head and writes.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_AN: I do not understand a nature that willingly pays a price for a brief moment of pleasure.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTE: [Acknowledge the suffering you created. Acknowledge that all things should not be manipulated at your whim.]
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Come rest here. Climbing the tower is so tiring......
NEOW.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Offer me your prayer, and I shall grant you the power to climb.
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_AN: A rare quiet traveler! Are you afraid of burning power?
PAEL.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Your notebook is packed with writing. It is not like the scraps others toss aside; it is a complete story......?
Yes. To have a place where one can lie down as one likes, without forcing oneself to be strong, is one of the greatest fortunes in the world.....
OROBAS.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANL: That notebook is full of other people's stories, just like the story fragments I collect!
TEZCATARA.talk.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_AN: Everyone in the tower chases battle, yet you alone prefer words that avoid conflict. How unusual. Take my blessing.
